items.finding: Architecture UI_UX_SYSTEM hard-codes Chats/Calls/People persistent destinations; R13C defaults to Chats-only and user-composable tabs with Calls/People optional.
items.recommended_resolution: Adopt R13C shell via architecture ADR; tabs are presentation only, capabilities remain accessible via Omnibar/context. Supersede old fixed-tab wording.

items.finding: Architecture already requires first-class global search/command palette and Cmd/Ctrl+K; R13C adds bottom Omnibar, local ranking, voice/keyboard grammar and composer morph.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge as detailed UI implementation semantics; keep Core intent boundary and local-index privacy rules.

items.finding: Architecture distinguishes AccountID from local IdentityProfile and exposes profile switching for 2+ profiles; R13C often says account generically.
items.recommended_resolution: Normalize user-facing wording as appropriate but map state/actions explicitly to IdentityProfile where architecture means profile. Never invent cross-profile heuristics.

items.finding: R13C says cross-device draft sync is not implied; architecture baseline explicitly permits V1 account-private E2EE draft sync with conflict preservation for eligible linked devices.
items.recommended_resolution: Revise draft spec: local durability required; private cross-device sync is architecture-supported V1 behavior when capability is available, with conflict-safe UX and no conversation authority.

items.finding: R13C marks scheduled messages v1 optional; architecture first-release baseline includes device-local scheduled send with sent-late/discard-on-ineligibility semantics.
items.recommended_resolution: Promote scheduled-send UX to architecture-required V1 product behavior, while preserving truthful local-device execution and actual-send late binding.

items.finding: R13C treats shallow Space→Channel as optional and deeper structures as v2+; architecture defines Spaces/Communities as Standard V1 and allows nested Spaces plus independently linked Rooms.
items.recommended_resolution: Keep default UI simple/progressive, but do not constrain protocol model to one level. UX must render/navigate architecture-valid nested Spaces safely, even if hidden until needed.

items.finding: R13C defers full forum/thread trees and lacks a Topic UX; architecture makes lightweight threads and persistent room-local topics Standard V1 capabilities.
items.recommended_resolution: Add bounded thread/topic UX before merge. Preserve simple reply as default; reveal topics only where a Room uses them.

items.finding: R13C has no Publication/broadcast UX; architecture defines signed public Publication as Standard V1 capability distinct from private Rooms.
items.recommended_resolution: Add Publication feed/follow/source/provenance UX with clear distinction from private Rooms and no implied E2EE.

items.finding: Architecture includes polls as Standard optional capability included in V1 product; R13C has an icon but no interaction/state design.
items.recommended_resolution: Add create/vote/close/result semantics and unsupported-capability fallback before scope freeze.

items.finding: Architecture requires first-class stickers and bounded looping animation in the product baseline; R13C defines asset packs/effects but not complete conversation interaction semantics.
items.recommended_resolution: Map content-pack/sticker selection, send, fallback and static/reduced-motion behavior into messaging UX.

items.finding: Architecture defines optional typing/presence/receipt semantics with privacy-policy control; R13C touches receipt states but lacks complete policy/presentation contract.
items.recommended_resolution: Add explicit presentation/privacy rules and map them to Recommended/Hardened/Maximum Privacy profiles.

items.finding: Architecture has canonical disappearing-message/retention semantics; R13C references them but does not design timer/expiry/view-once user flows.
items.recommended_resolution: Add conversation timer, per-message expiry/view-once presentation, backup/search implications, and honest non-erasure wording.

items.finding: R13C invite-first UX covers QR/link invites but does not fully cover ContactCapsule forwarding, provenance, constrained MessageRequest preview/accept/block.
items.recommended_resolution: Add Share Contact / Shared by <person> / Message Request flows mapped to architecture.

items.finding: R13C starts after identity/setup and invite CTA; architecture requires T0 sponsored mailbox/T1 hosted Home/T2 own cloud/T3 self-host/T4 local-only semantics and specific disclosures.
items.recommended_resolution: Integrate invite-first empty state with Home tier onboarding. Sponsored invite must disclose observer/closure facts and offer native or multiple independent PWA origins per V-018.

items.finding: R13C keeps recovery generic; architecture says recovery is on by default with synced passkey when possible, fallback recovery key, pending state when custodian cannot be established, and separate history recovery.
items.recommended_resolution: Revise recovery UX to architecture defaults and exact scope. Preserve user-friendly wording and explicit opt-out consequences.

items.finding: Architecture has Recommended/Hardened/Maximum Privacy operational privacy profiles; R13C has Focus/Balanced/Playful experience profiles but not the security/privacy preset surface.
items.recommended_resolution: Add Protection presets as a separate settings dimension; never conflate emotional/attention profiles with security/privacy policy.

items.finding: R13C centers Revoke device; architecture requires immediate Suspend/quarantine journey and may require later authorization for permanent removal, including Safety Freeze states.
items.recommended_resolution: Add Suspend device, pending/final control-state, contested/frozen state and permanent revocation as distinct actions.

items.finding: Both tracks separate cryptographic continuity, user verification and real-world identity and avoid route-as-security signaling.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge R13B language into canonical UX docs; retain architecture-specific continuity/safety-number source data.

items.finding: Both tracks keep calls conversation-anchored and route-independent for E2EE, with direct/LAN/TURN/SFU hidden unless diagnostics matter.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge detailed R13B states into call UI; preserve architecture CallSessionID/key/route semantics.

items.finding: R13B says a call event should be visible in the conversation; architecture explicitly keeps signaling outside durable ConversationEvents and permits local timeline materialization.
items.recommended_resolution: Rename to call timeline item/notice; do not imply a canonical durable ConversationEvent unless architecture later adds one.

items.finding: Architecture has V1 group-call capability where platform support exists; R13B provides group-call states and participant UX.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge, capability-gated by PlatformAdapter/Core.

items.finding: Both tracks use privacy-safe local rendering and platform-owned notification surfaces; architecture has detailed push/wake semantics.
items.recommended_resolution: Keep R13A attention model as presentation layer; architecture remains source for push/wake capability and privacy.

items.finding: Both tracks require local/profile-scoped search with no mandatory global search service; architecture encrypts search indexes at rest.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge Omnibar indexing/ranking under profile-scoped LocalDataClass rules.

items.finding: R13C adds optional local behavior-learning state; architecture forbids analytics/hidden cross-profile fingerprinting but lacks an explicit named adaptation-data class.
items.recommended_resolution: Map learning aggregates to profile-scoped private local state, encrypted at rest, resettable/export policy explicit; add architecture requirement/trace if normative.

items.finding: Both tracks require declarative data-only themes, protected security surfaces, light/dark pairs, accessibility override and no remote arbitrary code/tracking.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge R11-R13 asset/icon/token details beneath canonical theme boundary.

items.finding: Architecture explicitly treats imported fonts as hostile and reserves built-in fonts for security surfaces; R13C theme contract must retain this stricter rule.
items.recommended_resolution: Architecture rule wins; ensure asset/theme validator rejects unsafe fonts and security surfaces never use theme fonts.

items.finding: Both tracks define semantic/interruptible motion, direct manipulation and Reduced Motion.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge R13C richer semantic motion/delight taxonomy without weakening architecture performance/reduced-motion gates.

items.finding: R13C defines tighter interaction budgets; architecture V-022 owns normative speed/battery/memory/size budgets and requires real-device evidence/ADR for revisions.
items.recommended_resolution: Treat R13C numbers as component targets unless promoted by architecture ADR. Do not overwrite V-022 budgets silently.

items.finding: Both tracks require shared semantics, keyboard operation, visible focus, gesture alternatives, reduced motion and native accessibility adapters.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge R9/R10 component mappings and conformance harness as candidate evidence, not closure of human/AT gates.

items.finding: Architecture V-018 requires a multi-language non-technical participant study for onboarding/recovery/device/security flows. Human testing is intentionally deferred by user.
items.recommended_resolution: R14 cannot close V-018. Preserve it as an explicit pre-engineering blocker for reference_client_ui.

items.finding: Architecture V-022 still needs reviewed measurement-harness plan and later real-device measurements. R13C has prototype/browser metrics only.
items.recommended_resolution: Use R13C harnesses as inputs; do not claim V-022 passed.

items.finding: Architecture sponsored-invite flow must offer native plus multiple independent PWA origins and explain who serves the app; R13C invite install flow assumes a generic supported-client/PWA path.
items.recommended_resolution: Expand invite-install UX to origin/provider choice without overwhelming user; V-018 comprehension criteria remain authoritative.

items.finding: R13C no-contact-upload-by-default matches architecture rule that OS address book is convenience, not identity authority.
items.recommended_resolution: Merge as default; optional export/matching must preserve provenance and consent.

items.finding: Architecture requires Telegram-class RichText formatting and sanitized conversion; R13C messaging design does not fully specify formatting controls.
items.recommended_resolution: Add formatting UX, keyboard shortcuts, paste sanitization feedback and accessibility.

items.finding: Architecture has privacy-preserving optional link preview and Maximum Privacy off behavior; R13C lacks explicit preview policy UX.
items.recommended_resolution: Add per-profile/conversation link-preview controls and failure-neutral rendering.

items.finding: Architecture baseline includes Block and scoped Report/EvidencePackage flows; R13C does not fully design reporting/evidence export.
items.recommended_resolution: Add block/report/selective evidence UX without implying a universal OM moderator.

items.finding: Architecture canonically keeps public name OM with multiple meanings; R12 already warns against prematurely freezing expanded public names.
items.recommended_resolution: Keep OM as public name pending future clearance; identity visual testing remains separate.

items.finding: Architecture docs/ux-design SCREEN_MAP still fixes three tabs and older first-run OM Home setup, while newer canonical architecture and R13C have moved beyond it.
items.recommended_resolution: At merge, replace/supersede seed screen map and component catalog references rather than preserving contradictory UX docs.

items.finding: R13C Action Registry is UI-semantic; architecture UI_CORE_PLATFORM_CONTRACT requires typed intents and Core validation for authority/state transitions.
items.recommended_resolution: Create explicit action→typed Core intent/view-state mapping; UI actions never become protocol authority or generic string RPC.

items.finding: R13C deliberately leaves brand/logo/icon comprehension and physical ergonomics open.
items.recommended_resolution: Keep deferred; not a merge blocker for semantic UX, but blocks final brand/accessibility freeze.
